text:
The evidence doesn't cover 2026, so it can't say whether tree cover changed this year.

The assessment covers 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Over that period, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected within the 374.8 ha property. Valid satellite observations covered the whole property. The most recent observed year is 2025, so nothing from 2026 is included.

This doesn't prove that nothing changed, even in 2021–2025. Losses smaller than 0.5 ha, losses at the edges, or losses narrower than the 30 m pixels could be missed.

For context, the property had about 48.4 ha of tree cover in 2000 (Hansen) and about 43.3 ha of forest in 2020 (JRC), roughly 11.6% of the property.

The evidence also makes no regulatory or compliance finding, such as whether the property is deforestation-free.

To answer for 2026, you would need data covering that year.
